drill: G3 §25 stale policy, the local half: the control wire the cell polls (the halt flag's directory) vanishes as a lost mount would, so its reading can no longer be trusted; the cell treats stale as engaged and halts rather than trading on its last good reading (§46.2), and runs again once the wire reads. The fabric-published policy's staleness needs a policy publisher, which no local binary is; that half is not drilled here.

checks.name: the polled wire reads as not halted
the cell halts on the unreadable wire
the cell stays halted while the wire is unreadable
the cell runs again once the wire reads
